---
title: "Groups"
---

Coverage and model runs for each taxonomic group in the current release. Groups are
added one at a time.

```{=html}
<div id="groups"></div>
<script>
fetch('data/groups.json').then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
  const el = document.getElementById('groups');
  if (!d.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No groups published yet.</div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = '<table class="results"><thead><tr><th>Group</th><th>Species</th>' +
    '<th>Models</th><th>Runs</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    d.map(g => '<tr><td>' + g.group + '</td><td>' + g.n_species.toLocaleString() + '</td>' +
      '<td>' + [].concat(g.models).join(', ') + '</td>' +
      '<td>' + [].concat(g.dates).join(', ') + '</td></tr>').join('') +
    '</tbody></table>';
}).catch(() => {
  document.getElementById('groups').innerHTML =
    '<div class="empty">No data yet. Run <code>build.R</code>.</div>';
});
</script>
```

When available, cross validation performance for each model is reported in the repository alongside the predictions. Performance is given separately for threatened and non threatened species.
